title: 전문심리위원규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:5:00006:part:1/1

Article 2-5 (Composition of Selection Committees for Full-Time Expert Commissioners and Appraisal Management Commissioners, etc.)
(1) The Minister of the National Court Administration may establish a Selection Committee for Full-Time Expert Commissioners and Appraisal Management Commissioners (hereinafter referred to as a "Selection Committee") by field, including medicine and construction, to ensure proper handling of the selection and commissioning of candidates for those positions.
(2) Each Selection Committee shall consist of seven members, including one Chairperson and one Member in Charge.
(3) The Vice Minister of the National Court Administration shall serve as Chairperson, the Director General of the Judicial Support Office shall serve as Member in Charge, and the ordinary members shall be the following persons:
1. Two presiding judges of district courts or judges of high courts;
2. Two attorneys-at-law;
3. One university professor.
(4) Ordinary members shall be commissioned by the Minister of the National Court Administration, and their term of office shall be one year; they may be reappointed.
(5) Specific matters concerning the work of a Selection Committee shall be prescribed by internal regulations of the National Court Administration.
(6) Where necessary to perform its duties, a Selection Committee may request a court to provide the results of evaluations under Article 2-2 (5), including where that provision applies mutatis mutandis under Article 2-4 (3).
